cd /workspace/tmp/tests && cat > perf3.py <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
from syntax import parse
import compiler.compiler as C
from ebpf.create_dfa import registry_columns
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
cols,colmap=registry_columns(reg)
rng=random.Random(7)

def phases(label, text):
    t0=time.time(); res=parse(text); t1=time.time()
    cols_of=[colmap[n] for n in res.names]
    b=C._Builder(len(cols))
    allow=[];drop=[]
    for node,act in res.rules:
        (allow if act==1 else drop).append(b.translate(node,cols_of))
    root=b.mk_and((b.mk_or(allow), b.negate(b.mk_or(drop))))
    t2=time.time()
    trans,acc=C._explore(root,b)
    t3=time.time()
    n=len(trans)
    live=C._coreachable(trans,acc,n)
    t4=time.time()
    trans2,acc2,start=C._contract(trans,acc,live,n)
    t5=time.time()
    cls=C._minimize(trans2,acc2,len(trans2))
    t6=time.time()
    print('%-28s parse=%.2f translate=%.2f explore=%.2f(n=%d) coreach=%.2f contract=%.2f(n2=%d) minimize=%.2f classes=%d'
          %(label,t1-t0,t2-t1,t3-t2,n,t4-t3,t5-t4,len(trans2),t6-t5,max(cls)+1))

w=set()
while len(w)<4096: w.add(tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(16)))
p=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(x) for x in w)
phases('4096 words len16', p)

w2=set()
while len(w2)<2000: w2.add(tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(8)))
p2=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(x) for x in w2)+' endswith(S00,S01,S02,S03) drop;'
phases('2000 words len8 x endswith', p2)
p3=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(x) for x in w2)+' contains(S00,S01) drop;'
phases('2000 words len8 x contains', p3)
p4=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(x) for x in list(w)[:1000])
phases('1000 words len16', p4)
PYEOF
time python3 perf3.py
